Hi Harper — welcome, and thanks for the quick response.

Short answers up front:
- We prefer the legal name that matches the tax ID (EIN) on our vendor record and PO — if Solarex LLC is the entity tied to the EIN, please use that on the PO.
- We support domestic ACH and domestic/international wire instructions; if you expect USD wires from US buyers, provide both ACH and wire rails and indicate currency for each.
- Remit-to can be a separate address field on the PO; we usually record both headquarters and remit-to if different.

Next steps (please send back the items below):
1) Completed vendor intake form (I attached our Vendor Intake Workbook) — includes legal name, DBA, tax ID (last 4 ok in email), corporate address, remit-to, and payment preferences.
2) W-9 (you attached — thanks).
3) Bank letter or voided check for ACH; bank letter preferred for wire as it shows SWIFT/IBAN if international.
4) Any 3rd-party payment processors used (Stripe, Adyen, etc.).

I'll loop in Monica and Neha from Finance to confirm any additional KYC requirements. Once we have the intake form and bank letter we'll provision the vendor record and confirm PO routing and payment terms (Net 30 by default).

Forwarding the vendor intake workbook now.

Best,
